description: Source code for a Detectron2-based object detection model implementing DETR with segmentation capabilities, including classes for backbone wrapping and the main DETR model with training and inference methods.

classes.name: MaskedBackbone
classes.description: Wrapper around Detectron2 backbone to provide padding masks for feature maps.

classes.name: Detr
classes.description: Main DETR object detection model class with training and inference logic, supporting segmentation and backbone integration.

methods.name: MaskedBackbone.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the backbone and computes feature strides and channels.

methods.name: MaskedBackbone.forward
methods.description: Computes features and masks for input images.

methods.name: MaskedBackbone.mask_out_padding
methods.description: Generates padding masks for feature maps based on image sizes.

methods.name: Detr.__init__
methods.description: Constructs the DETR model, including backbone, transformer, criterion, and optional segmentation components.

methods.name: Detr.forward
methods.description: Performs a forward pass for training or inference, returning losses or detection results.

methods.name: Detr.prepare_targets
methods.description: Prepares ground truth targets for training.

methods.name: Detr.inference
methods.description: Generates detection results from model outputs during inference.
